narrative.intro: Veterans Development has $67.9M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Veterans Development won 3 awards in the period, with an average award size of $22.6M. Veterans Development saw year-over-year obligations change up 1916.4% compared with the prior fiscal period. Veterans Development obligations have varied across fiscal years: FY22 $11M, FY23 $18M, FY24 $2.3M, FY25 $24.1M, FY26 $3.4M, and FY27 $67.9M. Veterans Development FY2027 obligations concentrate in specific NAICS markets. Veterans Development top market is Commercial and Institutional Building Construction with $67.2M in obligations. Veterans Development also has work in Facilities Support Services with $693K in obligations. Current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the figures above are contract obligations except where noted otherwise in award-value tables.
